display_long_description:
Finger Gun VR - An Arcade Wave Shooter 🔫
This game delivers fast, straightforward VR shooting with a playful finger‑gun theme. Aim, fire, and survive as enemies approach from multiple directions. The focus is on quick sessions, simple controls, and score‑chasing action that’s easy to jump into.
⚡ Core Features
• Finger Gun Shooting: Use familiar VR controls to aim and fire with a finger‑gun style twist.
• Wave-Based Combat: Face waves of enemies that increase in speed and pressure as you progress.
• Encounters: Enemies come from different angles, keeping you alert and moving.
• Score‑Focused Gameplay: Try to survive longer and beat your previous high score.
🎯 Built for Meta Quest
Designed for standalone VR, Finger Gun VR features clean visuals, smooth performance, and responsive controls that keep the action fast and accessible.
🔁 Quick, Replayable Sessions
Each run is short, challenging, and easy to retry perfect for jumping in, improving your timing, and pushing for higher scores.
If you enjoy simple, arcade-style VR shooters with a fun twist, Finger Gun VR offers a light, replayable experience built for quick bursts of action.
